yt_title: Don't use AI to clone someone else's online store

fx.hook: THE LAST STEP IS THE PROBLEM

caption:
Don't clone someone else's store.

A saved reel (a sponsored post) said AI can clone any online store in minutes.
AI store builders are real and handy.
But copying another brand's photos, text or design can breach copyright and trademark.

Do this instead: study what works, then make your own photos, copy and name.
